basics.name: Jichun Zhao (Elliot Chiu)
basics.label: PhD Candidate, HIT Lab NZ; DISC101 Tutor, University of Canterbury
basics.summary: PhD Candidate at HIT Lab NZ and DISC101 Tutor at the University of Canterbury, researching Human–Computer Interaction, XR Accessibility, Digital Cultural Heritage, Ageing, and Handheld Augmented Reality.

education.institution: Tsinghua University and Jiangsu Normal University

publications.name: Protecting and Transmitting Intangible Cultural Heritage through Rural Revitalization: The Mazhuang Sachet Case
publications.publisher: Journal of Xuzhou University of Technology (Social Sciences Edition), 41(1), 9–16
publications.summary: A case study connecting the living transmission of the Mazhuang sachet tradition with community participation, cultural identity, and rural revitalization.

publications.name: Digital Preservation Pathways for Intangible Cultural Heritage in Xuzhou
publications.summary: A regional preservation pathway linking cultural context with digital collection, 3D modelling, public display, and participation.

publications.name: Practical Approaches to Intangible Cultural Heritage in Rural Revitalization: The Mazhuang Sachet Case
publications.publisher: Proceedings of the 2024 Annual Conference on Intangible Cultural Heritage
publications.summary: A conference paper on reactivating local heritage resources within rural revitalization.

publications.name: Designing Digital Museums for Intangible Cultural Heritage with Spatial Computing
publications.summary: An exploration of spatial computing for heritage preservation, interpretation, and public access in digital museums.

publications.name: Protecting and Transmitting Intangible Cultural Heritage through Rural Revitalization
publications.summary: Practice-oriented pathways for sustaining the Mazhuang sachet tradition through community and rural development.

publications.name: New Reflections on Modern Design Criticism
publications.summary: A study of the theoretical form, contemporary role, practical value, and educational significance of design criticism.

portfolio.name: XR Accessibility
portfolio.description: Research on inclusive extended reality systems, accessible interaction patterns, and evaluation methods for immersive technologies across diverse abilities and contexts.

portfolio.name: Handheld AR for Older Adults
portfolio.description: Exploring handheld augmented reality experiences for older adults, with attention to usability, accessibility, embodied interaction, and everyday value.

portfolio.name: Digital Cultural Heritage
portfolio.description: Digital approaches for documenting, interpreting, and sustaining tangible and intangible cultural heritage through interactive, immersive, and community-facing media.

portfolio.name: Rewi Alley Museum AR
portfolio.description: An augmented reality museum interpretation concept that connects visitors with Rewi Alley-related heritage through situated storytelling and mobile interaction.

portfolio.name: Digital Preservation of Intangible Cultural Heritage through Art–Technology Integration
portfolio.description: A Jiangsu Province Postgraduate Research Innovation Project examining digital preservation of intangible cultural heritage from an art–technology integration perspective.
